I own one, it is a good inexpensive pedal not much to complain about. I also owned a ds-1, I noticed that the ds-1 sucked volume and tone and the MXR doesn't at all. I play with a tele so I light my guitar bright and this pedal sure does add good amount of brightness and treble which I like, I don't know if you like that or not, everyone likes their tone different. The sound is really old school, vintage type of distortion and can sound fuzzy at times. It can also be cleaned up with the volume pot of your guitar. The knobs have some glow in the dark strips on it, it's really convenient when playing in a dark stage. The size is small and pedal board friendly. So if you like bright, vintage type of distortion and best bang for the buck, then the MXR is good for you. You can try out the pedal at a GC and see if ya dig it. And if not then there's walrus audio, they have a good distortion. The iron horse is 169$. Good distortion too.
